page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is an x86_64 GPU-accelerated compute instance powered by dual Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a 2.9 GHz base frequency. The instance delivers 128 dedicated virtual CPUs across 64 physical cores, paired with 752 GB of system memory. For hardware acceleration, it integrates four NVIDIA A10 GPUs based on the Ampere architecture, delivering a collective 96 GB of GDDR6 video memory (24 GB per card). High-speed interconnectivity is facilitated by a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, while instances rely entirely on remote network storage as no local disk storage is included.

Benchmark measurements reflect high aggregate multi-core throughput and memory subsystem capacity. In multi-threaded evaluation, stress-ng recorded 123,935.69 points (ranking in the top 25%), complemented by top-tier bzip3 multi-threaded decompression at 575.13 GB/sec. Large-block memory bandwidth sustains 253.9 GB/sec for uncached reads and 103.09 GB/sec for writes. Redis throughput reached 100.72 million SET operations per second, and static web serving throughput reached 61.52 GB/sec. Conversely, single-thread performance tests, such as single-core stress-ng (1882.5) and gzip compression (28.11 GB/sec), sit within middle-tier expectations, reflecting standard per-core execution speeds typical of high-density multi-socket server platforms.

From an operational tradeoff and cost perspective, the instance packs substantial multi-GPU acceleration and large RAM capacity into a single node, maximizing compute density for parallel computing. However, the absence of bundled local storage necessitates provisioning remote block storage for runtime scratch disks and data staging. The platform is well matched for distributed deep learning inference, graphics virtualization, real-time video transcoding, parallel data analytics, and large-scale in-memory computing workloads requiring substantial GPU coprocessing.
